title: MIPI RFFE slave (USID 5): register 0 write, register write / read, extended write / read with auto-increment over a 32 x 8 register file, broadcast writes, parity checks

irqs.name: PROTO
irqs.desc: a sequence was aborted: command, address or data parity error, or an unsupported command. Held in the core until the next SSC, so the bit is set again on every clock until then

notes: sclk (in) and sdata (bidirectional, needs a weak keeper to 0) are the RFFE bus; they pass through unchanged. PCLK oversamples the bus: SCLK phases must last at least four PCLK clocks.
The register file is reached over the RFFE bus only; the registers report its protocol errors.
